metaTitle: Custom Recycled PET Golf | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop custom recycled PET golf products at Perfect Imprints. Eco-friendly branded umbrellas and accessories for your next event.
introHtml: Recycled PET golf products let you showcase your brand while supporting sustainability. Made from post-consumer plastic bottles, these umbrellas and accessories offer the same durability as virgin materials but with a smaller environmental footprint. Perfect for corporate golf outings, tournaments, or eco-conscious giveaways, recycled PET items send a clear message that your organization values both performance and the planet. Choose from styles like the 60" Arc Cutter & Buck® rPET Golf Umbrella or the compact 38" Totes Mini Travel Umbrella for versatile branding options.
heroAltText: Custom recycled PET golf umbrellas with company logo, eco-friendly promotional products
